name: Akiyama Kiyoka
source: Kiyoka is a refined and elegant beauty. It's not immediately clear why she's come to the Yamano Inn. She'll either hurl sharp orders to our manager-in-training or cast sullen looks with a desperate silence. If Takayuki wants to overcome these obstacles, he's going to have to work delicately.
